title: Schedule of Payment and Rate Terms — Hardship Assistance Programs
content:
This schedule sets out, for each of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the payment and rate figures a plan works with, how interest is treated while the plan runs and the enrollment fee.

## Payment figures

| Program | Reduced payment percent (%) | Minimum plan installment (USD) | Maximum plan payment ratio (%) | Enrollment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | 50 | 25.00 | 50 | 0.00 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | 0 | 25.00 | 100 | 0.00 |
| Term Extension Modification | 0 | 25.00 | 100 | 0.00 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | 0 | 0.00 | 100 | 0.00 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | 0 | 50.00 | 0 | 0.00 |

- **Reduced payment percent**: plan installment as a percent of the scheduled installment; 0 when the program does not use a percentage payment.
- **Minimum plan installment**: smallest plan installment, USD; 0.00 when there are no plan installments.
- **Maximum plan payment ratio**: highest plan installment as a percent of the scheduled installment; 0 when not applicable.
- **Enrollment fee**: fee charged to enroll in the program, USD.

## Rate and modification figures

| Program | Plan rate (%) | Rate reduction points | Modified rate floor (%) | Max. term extension (months) | Max. total term (months) | Trial payments required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Reduced Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | 4.99 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Term Extension Modification | 0 | 3.0 | 5.99 | 24 | 84 | 3 |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | 6.0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

- **Plan rate**: fixed interest rate set during the plan, percent; 0 when the program leaves the rate unchanged.
- **Rate reduction points**: percentage points the base interest rate is permanently reduced by on completion; 0 when not applicable.
- **Modified rate floor**: lowest rate a permanent modification can set, percent; 0 when not applicable.
- **Maximum term extension**: most months a permanent modification may add to the remaining term; 0 when not applicable.
- **Maximum total term**: longest total term (original plus extension) after a modification, months; 0 when not applicable.
- **Trial payments required**: plan installments that must be paid before modified terms become permanent; 0 when not a modification.

## Interest during the plan

| Program | How interest is treated during the plan |
|---|---|
| Short-Term Payment Deferral | accrues at the current rate on unpaid principal |
| Reduced Payment Plan | accrues at the current rate on unpaid principal |
| Temporary Rate Reduction Plan | accrues at the plan rate |
| Term Extension Modification | accrues at the current rate during the trial months |
| Disaster Relief Deferral | accrues at the current rate on unpaid principal |
| Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit | interest above the plan rate is forgiven, not deferred |
| Charged-Off Settlement Plan | no interest (charged-off balance) |

No program of the Hardship Assistance Programs charges an enrollment fee: the fee is 0.00 USD for all seven.
